groups.directions:
Read the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Eight persons sit in two parallel rows containing four persons each, in such a way that there is an equal distance between adjacent persons.
In Row 1: A, B, C, and D sit facing South.
In Row 2: P, Q, R, and S sit facing North.
Therefore, in the given seating arrangement, each member seated in a row faces another member of the other row.

• A sits at the extreme right end of the row.
• A faces P.
• R sits second to the right of P.
• The person facing R sits to the immediate left of D.
• B sits to the left of C.
• Q does not face B.

questions.explanation: Step 1: Row 1 faces South (Left means viewer's right, Right means viewer's left). Row 2 faces North. Positions are 1 to 4 from viewer's left to right.

questions.text: What is the position of Q with respect to R?
questions.explanation: Row 2: P, Q, R, S (facing North).

questions.text: Which of the following pairs sit at the extreme ends of their respective rows?
How many persons sit between A and C?
Who sits to the immediate right of the person who faces D?
questions.explanation: D is at Pos 2 and faces Q (Row 2, Pos 2).

groups.directions:
Read the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Ten persons sit in two parallel rows containing five persons each.
In Row 1: U, V, W, X, and Y sit facing South.
In Row 2: F, G, H, I, and J sit facing North.
Each person in Row 1 faces a person in Row 2.

• W sits third to the right of Y, who sits at an extreme end of the row.
• The person facing W sits second to the left of I.
• Only one person sits between I and F.
• V faces the person who sits to the immediate right of F.
• X sits to the right of U.
• H sits to the immediate left of the person who faces U.
• G does not face Y.

Refer to diagram: SVG/Q3.svg

questions.explanation: Step 1: Row 1 faces South. Y is at an extreme end. If Y=Pos 1(Left), right is off the grid. So Y must be at Pos 5(Right). 3rd right of Y is Pos 2 → W=2.

questions.text: What is the position of V with respect to Y?
questions.explanation: Row 1: X(1), W(2), V(3), U(4), Y(5). They face South.

questions.text: Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and so form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?
questions.explanation: X(1), Y(5), and G(1) sit at the extreme ends of their respective rows.

questions.text: Who sits exactly in the middle of Row 2?
How many persons sit between the one who faces V and J?
questions.explanation: V(3) faces H(3). J is at Pos 5.

groups.directions:
Read the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Fourteen persons sit in two parallel rows containing seven persons each.
In Row 1: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G sit facing South.
In Row 2: P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V sit facing North.

• P sits third to the right of S, and neither of them sits at an extreme end.
• The person facing P sits second to the left of B.
• Only two persons sit between B and A. A does not sit at an extreme end.
• C sits to the immediate right of A.
• The person facing C sits to the immediate left of V.
• U sits second to the left of T.
• Q does not sit at an extreme end.
• The person facing T sits to the immediate right of D.
• E sits to the left of F but to the right of G.

Refer to diagram: SVG/Q11.svg

questions.explanation: Step 1: Row 2 faces North. S and P are not at ends. P is 3rd right of S. Possibilities: S=2,P=5 or S=3,P=6.

questions.text: What is the position of D with respect to E?
How many persons sit between U and the person who faces A?
questions.explanation: U is at Pos 1 (Row 2). A is at Pos 6 (Row 1), so A faces V(6) in Row 2.

questions.text: Four of the following five are alike based on the given seating arrangement. Which one does not belong to the group?
questions.explanation: G(1), U(1), and F(7) sit at the extreme ends of their respective rows.

questions.text: Which of the following statements is true regarding Q?

options.label: C
options.text: Q sits second to the right of V

options.label: D
options.text: Exactly one person sits between Q and R

options.label: A
options.text: Q is at Pos 4 in Row 2, D is at Pos 4 in Row 1. Q faces D (True).

options.label: B
options.text: Q(4) is adjacent to T(3) and P(5), not U(1) (False).

options.label: C
options.text: Q(4) is second to the left of V(6), not right (False).

options.label: D
options.text: Q(4) and R(7) have two persons between them (P, V) (False).
